item.title: Serval的超级智能体Catalyst创建后台智能体，在IT问题被提交工单前识别并修复
item.summary: Serval is making Catalyst, its AI agent for building enterprise automations, generally available Thursday and enabling it by default for customers — allowing teams of AI agents to decide what should be automated and then build the automation itself.
